name: Awesome N8n Workflows
headline: awesome n8n workflows for productivity
short_description: A curated collection of awesome n8n workflows for automation, integration, and productivity. Explore ready-to-use JSON workflows for analytics, communication, CRM, e-commerce, finance, HR, marketing, monitoring, security, and more.
author: felipfr

sections.overview:
awesome-n8n-workflows is a public collection of production-ready n8n automation workflows covering 19 categories including analytics, communication, e-commerce, DevOps, social media, finance, and CRM. The repository aggregates workflows from various sources, enabling users to discover, import, and customize automation examples without building from scratch. Each workflow follows a consistent structure with clear naming conventions and is designed for easy customization through n8n's dashboard. Users can browse workflows by category, import JSON files directly into n8n, configure credentials, and deploy immediately. This resource serves automation enthusiasts, developers, and business teams seeking to reduce manual work through event-driven workflows, API integrations, scheduled tasks, and cross-platform automation.
Automate social media posting schedules to maintain consistent online presence.
Integrate CRM systems with email marketing tools for seamless lead management.
Create real-time dashboards for tracking business metrics and performance.
Set up automated notifications for team collaboration tools like Slack or Discord.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/felipfr/awesome-n8n-workflows`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
